description: text-generation-webui (oobabooga) is a popular Gradio-based web UI for running local LLMs with support for many backends (llama.cpp, ExLlama, Transformers) and extensions. This template uses the community-maintained Atinoda/text-generation-webui-docker image; the CPU build is shown here — swap the image tag for an nvidia/rocm variant (e.g. default-nvidia) if you have a GPU.
name: text-generation-webui
title: Text Generation WebUI (oobabooga)
